question: Identify the district name (A3) with the highest total active loan amount where the unemployment rate increased by more than 10% from 1995 to 1996. Also return the calculated unemployment increment percentage for that district.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_018 AS district_name,
       CAST((d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS REAL) * 100 / d.XCL_028 AS unemployment_increment_percentage
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
JOIN loan l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
WHERE l.XCL_039 = 'A'
  AND CAST((d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS REAL) * 100 / d.XCL_028 > 10
GROUP BY d.XCL_017, d.XCL_018, d.XCL_028, d.XCL_029
ORDER BY SUM(l.XCL_036) DESC
LIMIT 1

       CAST((d.XCL_029 - d.XCL_028) AS REAL) * 100 / d.XCL_028 AS unemployment_increment_percentage

GROUP BY d.XCL_017, d.XCL_018, d.XCL_028, d.XCL_029
ORDER BY SUM(l.XCL_036) DESC
